name: NorthWest Crossing
label: NorthWest Crossing
about_prose: NorthWest Crossing is a 488-acre master-planned, mixed-use community on the west side of Bend, developed beginning in 1999 by Brooks Resources Corporation and the Tennant family through their West Bend Property Company. The plan follows new-urbanist principles: a grid of tree-lined streets with front porches, traffic circles, and a walkable neighborhood center along NW Crossing Drive that mixes restaurants, retail, and LEED-certified commercial buildings. The community reached 1,335 residential units at buildout, from cottages and townhomes to single-family homes, with every home required to meet Earth Advantage certification standards.

The neighborhood holds more than 50 acres of parks, including the 40-acre Discovery Park (with a 3-acre lake, off-leash dog area, community garden, and trail connections to 650-acre Shevlin Park) and the 5-acre Compass Park, which anchors the center and hosts the weekly farmers market and a summer outdoor-movie series. High Lakes Elementary, Pacific Crest Middle School, and Summit High School serve the community. The NorthWest Crossing Saturday Farmers Market runs late May through late September.

amenities.name: Discovery Park
amenities.description: A 40-acre park with a 3-acre lake, natural play area, fenced off-leash dog park, community garden, and trails connecting to Shevlin Park.
amenities.access: Public, Bend Park and Recreation District

amenities.name: Compass Park
amenities.description: A 5-acre circular park at the neighborhood center, with a picnic shelter, open lawn, and a stage used for summer movie screenings.
amenities.access: Public, Bend Park and Recreation District

amenities.name: NW Crossing Drive Neighborhood Center
amenities.description: A mixed-use commercial corridor of LEED-certified buildings with restaurants, cafes, local businesses, and offices, including The Grove food hall.

amenities.name: Saturday Farmers Market
amenities.description: Held every Saturday late May through late September, 10am to 2pm, on NW Crossing Drive, with over 150 vendors.

amenities.name: Neighborhood Schools
amenities.description: High Lakes Elementary, Pacific Crest Middle School, and Summit High School (Bend-La Pine Schools) serve the community.

amenities.name: Phil's Trail Access
amenities.description: The trail network connects to the broader Phil's Trail mountain-bike and running system, about 10 minutes by bike.

drive_times.note: West edge of Bend via NW Newport Ave
